AXETS.Title: Axecleft's Tool Suite
AXETS.MenuHint: Enable or disable the installed Axecleft modules and check for updates.
AXETS.Intro: Turn suite modules on or off for this world and check GitHub for new versions.
AXETS.HubLocked: The Tool Suite manager stays enabled while you use it.
AXETS.CopyManifest: Copy manifest URL (paste it in Setup → Add-on Modules → Install Module)
AXETS.UpdateNote: Updates and new installs are done from Foundry's Setup screen: Add-on Modules → Update All updates every installed suite module.

Notify.UpdatesStartup: Axecleft's Tool Suite: {count} update(s) available. Install them from the Setup screen (Update All).
Notify.NoUpdates: All installed Axecleft modules are up to date.
Notify.CheckFailed: Could not check for updates. See the console for details.
Notify.MissingRequired: Can't enable — required module not installed: {list}
Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can manage the Tool Suite.

Notify.Name: Update notice on startup
Notify.Hint: When a GM loads the world, check for Axecleft module updates (at most every 6 hours) and show a notice.

ApplyDialog.Title: Apply Module Changes
ApplyDialog.Content: These modules will be changed and the world reloaded:

AXETS.ForFoundry: Checking the module builds for Foundry {version} (Foundry 13-14 from each module's repository, Foundry 11-12 from its v11 repository).
